findings.title: Recheck every reviewed input after backup before saving
findings.problem: The full input hash loop precedes copy2. After backup creation only Project.xlsx is rechecked. A regional handoff or plan/replacement file changed during backup can therefore still authorize the central save.
findings.reproduction: qa_probes.py metadata_case(True) uses a copy2 hook that completes the backup then replaces a hash-bound regional handoff. apply() returns without error and saves the new paper record while the handoff no longer matches its reviewed SHA256.
findings.minimal_change: Repeat the full checks.items() hash loop after copy2 immediately before write_book; add a synthetic handoff-change-during-backup rejection regression.
findings.current_real_case: No actual stale handoff observed; the finding concerns an unguarded before-save interval.

findings.title: Apply relocation resolution to registry paths
findings.problem: datasets() resolves historical material_files paths through SourcePaths, but the role registry indexes raw paths. After a provenance-ledger relocation, the exact same contextual bytes at the resolved path bypass the review and can retain or acquire role main.
findings.reproduction: qa_probes.py context_cases() renames related.pdf to renamed-related.pdf with an archive_relocation.csv entry, rewrites an existing main material_files path, then reconciles against the unchanged registry. The file remains main and main_file_status becomes local_file_present although its bytes match the contextual review.
findings.minimal_change: Resolve role-registry paths through the existing SourcePaths(root).resolve mechanism before indexing; preserve containment, duplicate/conflict, and exact-hash guards; handle deliberately removed paths explicitly. Add a relocated-context regression.
findings.current_real_case: Both current registered files hash-match and remain context with main_file_status not_found.

In-memory accumulation also rejects repeated inserts for the same article ID.

Changed bytes downgrade to source/not_reassessed, remove role_evidence, retain the prior hash, and leave main_file_status not_found.
